title: Mixed Event — First Star After the Rain — Episode8 Our Starry Sky

meta.Event Outline: Saki has formed a band with her childhood friends and is enjoying what each day brings. She happens upon a poster for an observatory event one day and decides to plan a visit with her bandmates, but...

rows.Line: School SEKAI - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But how's your cold, Saki? Walking around in your PJs might not be the best idea.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Oh, right... My fever isn't completely gone yet, so I should probably go back.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sounds good. Let's reschedule our observatory trip for when it's next open to the public.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Okay. That's not going to be for a while, but I guess I'll just have to be patient...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hopefully the weather will be better then.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: If only the skies were always clear in our world, like here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Like here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Guys, I have a suggestion.
Maybe this could do in the meantime?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hm?
A few days later
bgm_area00001

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ichi!
Let's begin!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be there in a second.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Now, which bag did I put the juice and cups in...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Shall I pour the juice into the cups and carry them over there?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Oh, Miku! We'll take care of it! We've kind of just taken over your place so...!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I intend to join in, so I'd like to help too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I laid these down so we can lie down here.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
You even have mats.
They look very comfy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm sorry for acting like we own the place.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, that's fine.
This is your SEKAI after all.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hmm, I think I'll lie down too.
Oh, it's nice and fluffy.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Here's some juice for you!
I see you're getting settled in, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Hehe, want to join me?
Come lie down next to me.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line:
Sorry to keep you waiting!
I'll put the cookies and juice down here...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: It looks like we're ready to start.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Yesss! Do your thing, Hona!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Welcome, everyone. We hope you'll enjoy the wonderful views of tonight's starry sky.”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh yeah!
This is going to be sooo great!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Saki, keep it down.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: But isn't it better if the audience gets hyped?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Not in a planetarium...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “Let's look straight ahead at the northern sky. There you'll notice seven stars that appear brighter than all the others...”

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: They couldn't go to the observatory, so they came up with this make-believe planetarium instead.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I think this is a lovely idea.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Miku, I've been meaning to ask you... Did you come to the rooftop when I was talking to Saki?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, my cover was blown...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I had a feeling you were watching.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You didn't interrupt because you sensed I could get her to open up, didn't you? Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Sigh... Nothing gets past you, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: “...and here we have Regulus, a first magnitude star, which means it's among the brightest...”

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ngh... I'm getting... Sleepy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't you fall asleep now, Saki.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Hona's voice is so gentle...
It's like a lullaby and I can't help it...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Seriously, girl...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Why don't we take a break? Honami's been talking non-stop and could probably use one too.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I don't mind, but it seems that Saki needs a nap.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't let her nap or she'll just keep on sleeping until morning. Come on, Saki. Get up.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: You're so hard on me, Shiho...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Quiet you. Go and wash your face. It'll wake you up.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Or we could play a song together.
That's sure to wake you up!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, yes! Performing under the starry sky... How wonderful!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Yay, let's do this!
Which song are we going to do?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Performing with Miku and Luka? Umm...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki's perked up already.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Heh, you're so easy...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: But I'm also down for playing...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Let's do it!!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Oh, but can I just say something?
Before I forget?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Sure, what is it?

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: So, um...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This planetarium, and playing in a band with Miku and Luka makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: This time spent with you all has been so amazing.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I hope we can keep doing things like this and make more great memories together.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: That's the plan!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
(Everything will be okay now.
No more anxiety. No more being scared.)

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: (I'll take my time and enjoy every day as it comes. Together, with my friends.)
